transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. To start, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening.  
Try to avoid heavy work or anything strenuous for 1 month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.  
If you’re running low, your GP should be able to give you more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Mild light sensitivity can be normal while the eyes adjust to the new lenses. If things just seem brighter, sunglasses outside can help.

But if it is severe, or you have strong pain, or the eye is red and painful too, that is not normal and we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I understand, thank you. One last question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Has all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thanks again for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass

All points were covered.
